reading.body:
CyrusOne Sterling is a 24 MW data center campus in Northern Virginia's Ashburn corridor, part of a region that holds 1,375 MW of published capacity across 23 facilities. At a typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, 24 MW of IT load translates to roughly 600 racks, an assumption that varies with workload mix and cooling overhead. The campus ranks 15th among Virginia facilities with published capacity.

The facility occupies 154,230 square feet of technical space. No building-specific maximum capacity is published. No certifications are listed on the operator's specification page, so qualified use cases cannot be read from the published record.

CyrusOne operates this campus as a private company after being taken private in 2022. The campus sits in a region of dense data center deployment where 326 facilities have been mapped but only 23 publish their power specifications, meaning most regional capacity is unquantified and the true ranking of this site's importance to the regional grid is unknown.
